handoff: appendProgress finds Progress at any heading level and ends it at the next heading as high; regression test covers levels 1-4 and edge cases, green. 1 minor finding (case-sensitive match), none blocking.

findings.title: Progress match is case-sensitive, unlike dropSection
findings.detail:
dropSection (packages/core/src/brief.ts:388) matches section titles with the 'i' flag. appendProgress matches /^#{1,6}\s+Progress\s*$/ without it, so a handoff headed '### progress' still gets a second '## Progress' section. That is outside the reported repro (level-3 'Progress') but is the same shape of bug.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add the 'i' flag, plus a test case with a lowercase heading.
